title: Harbor Operations Wallboard — fictional failure example

source.name: Dorkflow Design Atlas template authors; not based on a real product

rationale: In this imagined wallboard, every metric and action has equal weight, status is communicated only by color, and alerts pulse continuously. Important signals compete with routine information, color-only meaning is fragile across viewing conditions, and persistent motion distracts when no action is needed.
techniqueNotUniversallyBanned: Dense dashboards, color coding, and motion can be useful when a real task calls for them; preserve clear hierarchy, non-color status cues, and respect for motion preferences.
